definitions.explanation: A discharge of lightning striking the ground, a building, or other object. Can cause damage, fires, or injury.

examples.japanese: {落雷|らくらい}で{木|き}が{燃|も}えた。
examples.english: A tree caught fire from a lightning strike.

examples.japanese: {落雷|らくらい}による{停電|ていでん}が{発生|はっせい}した。
examples.english: A power outage occurred due to lightning.

examples.japanese: {建物|たてもの}に{落雷|らくらい}した。

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{落|お}ちる/らく (to fall) + {雷|かみなり}/らい (thunder/lightning)

USAGE AS VERB:
{落雷|らくらい}する - for lightning to strike
・ビルに{落雷|らくらい}した (lightning struck the building)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{落雷|らくらい}による{被害|ひがい} (damage from lightning)
・{落雷|らくらい}で{停電|ていでん} (power outage from lightning)
・{落雷|らくらい}{事故|じこ} (lightning accident)
・{落雷|らくらい}を{受|う}ける (to be struck by lightning)

SAFETY NOTE:
During thunderstorms, avoid tall isolated objects, open fields, and water. Taking shelter in buildings or cars is recommended.

RELATED WEATHER WORDS:
・{雷|かみなり} - thunder, lightning
・{雷雨|らいう} - thunderstorm
・{稲妻|いなずま} - lightning flash
・{雷鳴|らいめい} - thunder (sound)
